blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Drink your tea or it will get cold.
exercises.ru: Пей чай, ___ остынет.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: And now a word from our sponsor.
exercises.ru: ___ теперь слово от нашего спонсора.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: It might sound like I'm complaining, but I'm not.
exercises.ru: Может показаться, что ною, ___ это не так.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Peppa Pig is four years old, and George is eighteen months old.
exercises.ru: Свинке Пеппе четыре года, ___ Джорджу полтора.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: And then everyone started laughing.
exercises.ru: ___ затем все засмеялись.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The situation was difficult, but Liisa helped Markku out of a jam.
exercises.ru: Положение было нелёгкое, ___ Лиза помогла Марку выбраться из передряги.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: She sings well, to be sure, but she can't act.
exercises.ru: Поёт-то она хорошо, ___ актриса из неё никакая.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: You are mistaken: he plays double bass, not trombone.
exercises.ru: Ты ошибаешься: он на контрабасе играет, ___ не на тромбоне.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I know it sounds crazy, but it's true.
exercises.ru: Знаю, звучит бредово, ___ это так.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom tried to kiss Mary, but she leaned back.
exercises.ru: Том пытался поцеловать Мэри, ___ она отклонилась.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The right bank of the river is steep, but the left slopes gently.
exercises.ru: Правый берег реки обрывистый, ___ левый пологий.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The car isn't orange, it's khaki-coloured.
exercises.ru: Машина не оранжевая, ___ цвета хаки.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: He's not even 30 and he has a receding hairline.
exercises.ru: Ему ещё нет тридцати, ___ у него уже залысины.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: A disjointed people will perish, while a united one will come out ahead.
exercises.ru: Несплочённый народ пропадёт, ___ сплочённый - будет впереди.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: What if it's not a hypothetical question?
exercises.ru: ___ что если это не гипотетический вопрос?
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: He used to be a professor, but now he is the dean.
exercises.ru: Раньше он был преподавателем, ___ теперь он декан.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: In Russia they write "Tallin", and in Estonia they write "Tallinn" in Russian.
exercises.ru: В России пишут «Таллин», ___ в Эстонии по-русски пишут «Таллинн».
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: "Michael" is a man's name, but "Michelle" is a woman's name.
exercises.ru: Майкл — это мужское имя, ___ Мишель — женское.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Einstein was not only a scientist, but also a social activist and a humanitarian.
exercises.ru: Эйнштейн был не только учёным, ___ также общественным деятелем и гуманистом.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: They write 'Manchester' but read 'Liverpool'.
exercises.ru: Пишется Манчестер, ___ читается Ливерпуль.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
